categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies transaction creation and fee bumping in src/wallet/feebumper.cpp and src/wallet/spend.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents an anomalous on-chain wallet fingerprint caused by anti-fee-sniping locktime backdating during RBF. As described in the problem, random anti-fee-sniping backdating can cause replacement transactions to receive an older locktime than the original, creating an identifiable fingerprint; fixing this provides a clear privacy improvement to transaction creation.
